name: Debug systematically
summary: Trace failures to an evidenced root cause before making a bounded repair.
description: A four-stage debugging procedure for reproduction, backward tracing, discriminating hypotheses, and regression proof across single or multi-component systems.
risk_reason: This skill traces failures to an evidenced root cause before making a bounded repair; it does not claim resolution without fresh regression verification.
refuses: It does not modify production code before an evidenced hypothesis exists.
It does not expose secrets or customer payloads while adding diagnostics.
It does not claim resolution without fresh regression verification.

operational.latency_reason: The skill traces failures to an evidenced root cause before making a bounded repair, using sequential evidence and verification steps.
